name: District Electoral Areas 1992, Map 2: Western Area (Raster)
description: OSNI's map for the District Electoral Areas Commissioner's final recommendations, Local Government District Electoral Areas: 1992, Map 2: Western Area, Final Recommendations. It shows the district electoral areas (purple) and their wards (green) within each district (black), and its table lists each area's wards and its electorate on the 1991 register. Printed scale 1:150,000. The whole sheet is placed by its main map, so its insets and table fall where that placement puts them. Georeferenced to OSNI's 1993 ward boundaries with an affine fit (RMS 29 m over 267,070 matched boundary points).

references.label: OSNI Open Data - Largescale Boundaries - District Electoral Areas (1993) - Open Data NI (admin.opendatani.gov.uk)

Recommendations for the Grouping of Wards into District Electoral Areas for the purpose of Local Government Elections in Northern Ireland: Report by the District Electoral Areas Commissioner, Dr Maurice Hayes (Belfast: HMSO, December 1992)
references.note: Final recommendations. Appendix I lists each district electoral area with its wards and its electorate on the 1991 register; OSNI printed the same figures as "Area Electorate" on the four final-recommendation maps (Local Government District Electoral Areas: 1992, Maps 1-4, Final Recommendations). Each area on this map carries its figure (dea1992_electorate); the 101 sum to 1,132,617 and every district agrees with the printed district electorate. 90 areas are unchanged from the provisional recommendations of 20 August 1992; in Ballymena (Ballymena North 12,004; Ballymena South 12,151; Bannside 8,964; Braid 8,722), Carrickfergus (Knockagh Monument 8,426; Kilroot 8,696; Carrick Castle 6,847), Magherafelt (Magherafelt Town 9,303; Moyola 7,930) and Strabane (Mourne 9,619; Derg 8,055) the final groupings and figures differ, and Coleraine West was renamed Coleraine Central (10,194). Printed report; no online copy found.

references.label: District Electoral Areas (Northern Ireland) Order 1993 (S.I. 1993 No. 226)
references.note: Gave effect to the 1992 recommendations for the May 1993 local elections.
